raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The DE-412 change added a filter to silver_transactions that drops rows where ingest_ts minus txn_ts exceeds 26 hours. Batches deliver transactions about 68 hours after they occurred, so valid POSTED late-arriving rows were being discarded from batch 3 onward. The remaining gap is REVERSED rows, which are correctly excluded. Removing the stale filter restores the missing rows, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.6,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
